findings.passage: Widespread civilian gun ownership and serious expectations of firearm responsibility can coexist. We should not be afraid to borrow some successful policies from other countries with strong firearm traditions, such as thorough background checks, safe storage education campaigns, and serious consequences for criminal misuse. Through it all, we should rely on evidence to inform which policies we should adopt, revise, and repeal to protect public safety without undue infringement of our rights.
